about: Refresh of 2026-11-18: how faces die, audited from outside (CLAIMS DY16-DY21); the long tubes to 120 cells, the loop-21 face on two codes, the equilateral 108-cell face (WL9-WL11); the seventh, eighth, 8b and ninth signals pushes (SG33-SG38). Every item is checked by collect.py against research/NOTEBOOK.md, research/CLAIMS.md or the named file; the tables of the blast audit are read by collect.py from research/audit/blast/data/ and asserted against the quotes here.

words: two or more units behind the last
add.quote: Two pulses that meet leave a standing stretch `d f`; every later pulse that reaches it from either side, two or more units behind the last, is absorbed and lengthens it by one (`d^k f`; capacity N − 4; a block of m adjacent pulses adds ⌈m/2⌉).

words: exactly k pulses two units apart
release.quote: The count comes back out: removing one stator beside a stretch `d^k f` at an even generation dissolves it into exactly k pulses two units apart and leaves the wire plain from generation 2k + 6, for every k (chart gluing on the tape theorem; refereed, three gaps closed by the review).

catch.quote: A second store two or more units away catches them and holds k + 1.

negative.quote: Within the wire's tube nothing that arrives as a pulse starts the release (48 standing structures, k = 3); outside the tube that fails (see the ninth push)

gradeSG34.quote: A (the release for every k: proof refereed, base cases on the oracle by two codes) + B (the other laws and the catch: two steppers) + C (the negative: one search, replayed)

line7b.quote: an echo E and n holes turn it into a standing wire B capped at both ends, period 4 from generation 100, holding the count as a stretch of the variant wire. openaa.quote: **(aa)** a decrement that leaves the count where it can be decremented again (every release goes left; nothing moves a count to the right); **(ab)** the one-less collision at the oscillator's call, where the zero exit is the kind of pulse that starts the next call; **(ac)** any operation started by a signal the machine made itself (a source for the calling pair is (y)); **(ad)** schedules that respect the hazards (4k + 2 generations between calls, no call near a travelling pulse, adds from the right only); **(ae)** a referee for the proof of the call law, and a proof of the oscillator's law (measured to k = 10).

corrections.now: On two codes the face is 17.5411 ± 0.0023, midway between the two forecasts: the lean is withdrawn, undecided
corrections.by: the lead, pooling the card's CPU second code with its GPU value
corrections.quote: **Since (2026-11-18): on two codes the face is 17.5411 ± 0.0023, midway between the two forecasts; the lean is withdrawn, undecided.**

corrections.said: No gun survives an echo (every gun listed, and a search within bounds)
corrections.now: True of the 67 guns at C ≤ 37. Of the 867 at C ≤ 39, 34 are left standing and changed, and from then on fire a hole with every rake (one code on the oracle's step; nobody has repeated it)
corrections.quote: **[review; the oracle, one code] Refuted: "no gun survives E".**
corrections.src: NB 2026-11-18, three more signals results in one night (the seventh push, reviewed); CLAIMS SG36

corrections.said: CN2: the hull face of 108 cells (the ledger id was used twice; this site's sources of 2026-11-16 cite that row as CN2)
corrections.now: The hull face's row is CN5, renamed on 2026-11-16; CN2 is the analyst's forecasts
corrections.quote: (Entered at first as a second CN2 by mistake; renamed CN5 on 2026-11-16. CN2 is the analyst's forecasts.)

audits.label: Audit of how a face dies (the other session's night)
audits.line: Own stepper and death recorder from the oracle's offsets, traced against the oracle with a control that fails: a wrapped face crashes, a hull face fades, the rim row is why; no price derived; the lead re-ran it on fresh seeds.

audits.label: Review of the seventh signals push
audits.line: The line that turns itself into a register rebuilt on the oracle; the census reproduced with another solver; 34 of 867 guns survive the echo changed.

audits.label: Review of the eighth signals push
audits.line: The memory cell on the oracle by a second code; the proof of the release for every k refereed, three gaps closed; corrections to the censuses.

audits.label: Review of push 8b, in part
audits.line: The read from a crossing wire confirmed on the oracle; a single pulse never reads; no write with a reader in place at one placement.

audits.label: The card's third chain, recomputed
audits.line: The long 12-tubes on eight seeds, the loop² 13 and 16 tubes and the CPU second code, from the rows.

audits.label: The 120-cell tube and the dying-face tables, recomputed
audits.line: The 120-cell tube and the four long 12-tubes from the rows; the GTX 1080 studies of dying faces from their CSVs.

audits.label: Review of the ninth signals push
audits.line: Own harness and sparse stepper on the oracle: the call stands to k = 40 and its law is proved for every k (not refereed); three hazards; a call by one pulse at P3.15f; one less, with a zero exit; write, read and call do not coexist.

milestones.text: The equilateral 108-cell wrapped face to ± 0.007: between the two forecasts again
A memory cell: pulses write a count, one changed cell gives it back as that many pulses, proved for every k
A line that turns itself into a register; 34 guns survive the echo; a read and a call from a crossing wire
The 120-cell tube: four errors below the line; the lean on the loop of √21 withdrawn
How a face dies, audited from outside: a wrapped face crashes, a hull face fades; the rim row is why
The ninth signals push reviewed: the call proved for every count (not refereed); a call by one pulse; one less, with a zero exit
The 84-cell hull face: 1.07% of deaths by a fall of half the face, flat from 63 cells; the forecast held
